responsibility: This header provides the core GCC target configuration for MIPS systems that use GNU userland conventions. It sets target defaults such as abicalls-based PIC, preprocessor builtins, linker and assembler specs, small-data policy, native CPU detection hooks, math/start/end file handling, and local-label conventions, making it the main user-space OS configuration layer that Linux-derived headers build on for MIPS GNU environments.
